stories.t: Study attempts to tally hyperscalers’ energy use and emissions.

stories.h: Ultracold diamond microwave laser amplifies quantum signals 1,000-fold
stories.t: Researchers from the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST) have created a spin-based microwave amplifier that operates near absolute zero, boosting signals by more than 1,000-fold while adding noise close to the bare minimum required by the laws of physics.

stories.h: A Collage Showing 49 Drill Holes Made by NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover
stories.t: Description This collage shows 49 drill holes captured by NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover as of November 2026.

stories.h: What Makes Up the Cosmos? A 20-Year Survey Hints That Something Is Missing.
stories.t: An era-defining galaxy survey has released its final results. They don’t quite fit the leading theory of cosmology. The post What Makes Up the Cosmos? A 20-Year Survey Hints That Something Is Missing.

stories.h: NASA is offering $1 million for bold ideas to help build a Moon base
stories.t: S. students to develop innovative solutions for building humanity’s first permanent lunar outpost. From power systems to astronaut safety, their ideas could help make long-term life on the Moon possible and pave the way to Mars.
